stories.title: Iran: Donald Trump lehnt Teherans Vorschlag zur Straße von Hormus ab

en.title: Iran: Donald Trump rejects Tehran's proposal on Strait of Hormuz
en.summary: Iran's leadership presented the United States with a proposal regarding opening the Strait of Hormuz, which Trump declined to accept.

stories.title: Arbeiter gestorben: Kolosseum nach Todessturz wieder offen

en.title: Worker dies: Colosseum reopens after fatal fall
en.summary: A young worker fell from a height of ten meters overnight, resulting in his death. The Colosseum remained closed for three days following the incident.

stories.title: UN-Generaldebatte: Außenminister Wadephul trifft russischen Amtskollegen Sergej Lawrow

en.title: UN General Debate: Foreign Minister Wadephul meets Russian counterpart Sergej Lavrov
en.summary: On the sidelines of the UN General Assembly in New York, German Foreign Minister Wadephul held a meeting with his Russian counterpart Lavrov, with Germany having apparently initiated the appointment.

stories.title: Wahrzeichen Roms: Kolosseum nach Todessturz wieder offen

en.title: Rome landmark: Colosseum reopens after fatal fall
en.summary: The Colosseum has reopened following a fatal worker accident.

stories.title: Trump lehnt Irans Vorschlag zur Öffnung der Straße von Hormus ab

en.title: Trump rejects Iran's proposal to open the Strait of Hormuz
en.summary: Iran proposed to the United States a plan to reopen the Strait of Hormuz, which has been practically blocked for shipping since the start of the Iran war. US President Trump has rejected this proposal.

stories.title: Olympia-Bewerbung von München: »Olympia gehört nach Deutschland«

en.title: Munich's Olympic bid: "Olympics belong in Germany"
en.summary: Munich has been selected as Germany's candidate to host the Olympic and Paralympic Games. Chancellor Friedrich Merz and sports organizations have welcomed this decision.

stories.title: Straße von Hormus: Trump lehnt Hormus-Plan der Iraner ab

en.title: Strait of Hormuz: Trump rejects Iranian plan
en.summary: The US President has rejected Iranian proposals to open the Strait of Hormuz and posted a map featuring a "Trump Strait."

stories.title: Krieg in der Ukraine: Johann Wadephul trifft Sergej Lawrow zu Gesprächen

en.title: War in Ukraine: Johann Wadephul meets Sergey Lavrov for talks
en.summary: German and Russian foreign ministers met in New York for the first time since Russia's invasion of Ukraine began. The meeting between Johann Wadephul and Sergey Lavrov was brief.

stories.title: Newsblog zum Ukraine-Krieg: Wadephul und Lawrow treffen sich zu Gesprächen

en.title: News blog on Ukraine war: Wadephul and Lavrov meet for talks
en.summary: Germany's foreign minister and Russia's foreign minister met on the sidelines of the UN General Assembly in New York in their first bilateral meeting.

stories.title: Liveblog Ukrainekrieg: Wadephul trifft Lawrow zu Gesprächen in New York

en.title: Live blog Ukraine war: Wadephul meets Lavrov for talks in New York
en.summary: The foreign ministers held their first meeting since Russia's full-scale invasion began in 2022, while Serbia's president spoke with Putin and Ukraine's leader accused Russia of daily escalation.

stories.title: Olympia-Kandidat: München geht für Deutschland ins Rennen

en.title: Olympic candidate: Munich enters the race for Germany
en.summary: Munich prevailed over Cologne/Rhine-Ruhr in the selection of Germany's Olympic bid candidate, sending signals that extend beyond sports.

stories.title: Deutschland geht mit München ins Olympia-Rennen

en.title: Germany enters Olympic race with Munich
en.summary: Munich has been selected to bid for the Summer Olympic Games, while Cologne/Rhine-Ruhr was not chosen.

stories.title: Bundestag: Erneute Kritik an Spahn in der Unionsfraktion

en.title: Bundestag: Fresh Criticism of Spahn in Union Faction
en.summary: Jens Spahn, who resigned as faction leader in July, now serves on the budget committee. Some faction members are calling for his exclusion following a photograph.

stories.title: Pflegeversicherung: SPD will bei Pflegereform Leistungskürzung verhindern

en.title: Care Insurance: SPD Wants to Prevent Benefit Cuts in Care Reform
en.summary: The care insurance system faces billion-euro deficits, and the CDU health minister plans to initiate a policy reversal in cabinet next week. The coalition partner is applying pressure ahead of this decision.

stories.title: Olympia: Entscheidung gefallen – München Kandidat für Olympische Spiele

en.title: Olympics: Decision Made – Munich Candidate for Olympic Games
en.summary: German Olympic Committee delegates voted to select either Munich or the Cologne-Rhine-Ruhr region as Germany's candidate to host the Olympic Games.

stories.title: Krankenversicherung: Ökonomen schlagen Solidarbeitrag für Gutverdiener vor statt Bürgerversicherung

en.title: Health Insurance: Economists Propose Solidarity Contribution for High Earners Instead of Public Insurance
en.summary: Economists from the Kiel Institute propose a middle path between the current system and universal public insurance, allowing private insurance to remain while requiring higher earners to contribute more.

en.title: The World in Pictures: Eye-Catching
en.summary: A photographic collection showcases images that impress, provoke, fascinate, and alarm, capturing significant moments, small wonders, and stories from around the world.
